record.original_question: Is the automorphism group of a generic Engel manifold trivial?

evidence.quote: Question 2.13. Is the automorphism group of a generic Engel manifold trivial?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An Engel structure on a smooth 4-manifold M is a smooth rank-2 distribution D ⊂ TM such that [D,D] is a rank-3 distribution and [[D,D],[D,D]] = TM; the pair (M,D) is called an Engel manifold. An automorphism of (M,D) is a diffeomorphism φ: M → M with φ_*D = D, and Aut(M,D) denotes the group of all such automorphisms.

Equip the space of Engel structures on a fixed smooth 4-manifold with its natural C^∞ topology (or work in a suitable moduli/Baire-generic sense within this space). Determine whether, for a generic Engel manifold (M,D), the automorphism group Aut(M,D) is trivial, i.e., consists only of the identity diffeomorphism.
artifact.status_search_result: The existence of an Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group has been established (Yamazaki, arXiv:2002.02759; and the work on Developing Maps and Engel Automorphisms, arXiv:1903.02362). However, the question of whether a generic Engel manifold has trivial automorphism group — a genericity statement rather than an existence statement — does not appear to have been resolved in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Construction of an Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs an Engel manifold whose automorphism group is trivial.
status_evidence.claim: An example of an Engel manifold with trivial automorphism group exists, but this is an existence result rather than a genericity result.

status_evidence.title: Developing Maps and Engel Automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs an Engel manifold whose automorphism group is trivial via developing maps.
status_evidence.claim: Specific Engel manifolds with trivial automorphism group are constructed; genericity is not addressed.
